instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Mixed identity vocabulary navigation overlaps thirteen child cards; no additional independent teaching or assessed outcome.
Bot-activity challenge, not proof of a named identity.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Vocabulary for anti-automation; no identity-proofing, MFA, guaranteed bot exclusion or evaluated security-control classification.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Extensible network authentication framework, not one mandatory method.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can refresh wireless authentication terminology; does not teach method selection, certificates, factor independence or secure configuration.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Identity-provider service role in application authentication.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can refresh federation roles; storage and authentication may be delegated. An IdP is not the Zero Trust Policy Engine/Administrator/Enforcement Point.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Legacy Cisco wireless method with password-attack risk.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Historical recognition only; no modern deployment competence or equivalence between LEAP and all EAP methods.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Authentication needs different factor types, not merely multiple prompts.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Partial factor refresh for m601, overlapping the previous MFA definition. It does not teach technical-category classification or compensating-control reasoning in m003/m203; an app label alone proves no phishing resistance.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Delegated limited resource authorization, distinct from end-user authentication.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can refresh authorization purpose; no complete OIDC/SSO trust flow, least-privilege implementation or secure token validation. Password avoidance describes an intended delegation benefit, not every historical grant.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: OAuth-based identity layer for authentication claims.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can contrast identity information with OAuth authorization; no token audience, issuer, signature, nonce or session validation is taught.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Legacy password exchange lacks its own confidentiality/replay protection.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Insecure-protocol recognition only; no claim about protection supplied by a separate outer transport and no secure replacement configuration.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Federal smart-card identity credential for physical and logical access.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can refresh credential vocabulary; possession alone does not prove a complete authentication event, certificate trust, every factor or control-category assessment.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Centralized AAA for network-access use cases.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can refresh network authentication service purpose; does not individually teach AAA role discrimination, accounting implementation, full-traffic encryption or protocol configuration.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Assertion exchange about identity/authentication and authorization.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can refresh federation vocabulary; no trust/signature, audience, assertion-consumption, access-policy or SSO implementation procedure.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: Reuse of a sign-in across participating trusted applications.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can refresh login-experience vocabulary; does not mean unlimited permission, permanent sessions, no reauthentication or Zero Trust policy implementation.

instructionalProposals.meaningProposal: AAA protocol commonly used for network-device administration.

postMissUsefulnessProposal.rationale: Can contrast administration with network-access use cases at recall level; no command authorization configuration, assured transport security or equivalence to legacy TACACS.

selectorBindings.limitation: Includes three mobile quick sets, saved/shared deck restoration and explicit deck/mode choice. Stored learner instances are excluded.
Term/acronym/example presentation, pass navigation and related lesson/deck actions reuse authored content. Self-rating is not trusted mastery evidence.
Continue-studying recommendation is ordered navigation, not personalized mastery.
Selection, dividers and saved-ID hydration reuse authored cards. Saved user deck contents are excluded.
Terms, objective overlap and domain matching; no canonical adaptive mapping dependence.
Selection algorithm included; personal selections are not catalogue revisions and are not queried.
Broad topic matching and chapter fallback; no adaptive canonical concept map is consulted.

separatelyScopedFollowups.detail: The whole deck inherits 1.2/1.4/3.2. Named IAM/federation/factor meanings chiefly concern 4.6; wireless authentication concerns 4.1. CAPTCHA, LEAP and PAP keep precise instructional scope withheld; inherited tags do not prove cryptographic or architecture coverage.

Qualify OAuth password-avoidance as appropriate delegated flow behavior, distinguish it from OIDC authentication, qualify IdP storage/delegation and MFA factor mechanisms. No security guarantee follows from a one-line protocol definition.

Existing saved-ID hydration sends a 13-card ID mix through the builder count-rounding rule, retaining ten. Investigate preservation in a separate delivery change; current exact behavior is recorded, not fixed here.

humanDecisionReferences.ownerDecision: All proposals remain pending; no queue closure, competence, publication or migration approval.
